title.zh: 恒指收涨877点(+3.67%)至24,796:科技股领涨,恒生科技指数大升5.55%
title.en: Hang Seng closes up 877 points (3.67%) at 24,796 as tech leads and the Hang Seng Tech Index jumps 5.55%

analysis.zh: 港股周四收盘,恒指涨877点至24,796点,成交额3,566亿港元,创近三个月新高;恒生科技指数升5.55%至4,154点,重返4,000点。阿里巴巴涨8.5%,腾讯涨7.2%,小米涨8.8%;中石油跌4.2%、中海油跌2.1%。报道指升势主要来自美国期中选举后的情绪,而民主党的结果被视为让伊朗战事降温的希望。
analysis.en: Hong Kong stocks closed sharply higher on Thursday: the Hang Seng Index rose 877 points to 24,796 on HK$356.6 billion turnover, a near three-month high, while the Hang Seng Tech Index gained 5.55% to 4,154, back above 4,000. Alibaba rose 8.5%, Tencent 7.2% and Xiaomi 8.8%, while PetroChina fell 4.2% and CNOOC 2.1%. The report attributes the rally mainly to sentiment after the US midterms, with the Democrats' result seen as raising hopes of an easing in the Iran war.

dda.zh: 单日急升的行情再次说明,很难预测哪一天会是转折点。定期定额(DDA)让你不必押注某一天,持续投入可能让成本在涨跌之间自然平均。
dda.en: A sharp one-day rally shows how hard it is to pick the turning point. Regular (DDA) investing means you do not have to bet on one day, and steady contributions may average your cost across ups and downs.

prs.zh: 退休规划看的是十几二十年,而不是一天的涨幅。若PRS基金含有中国或亚洲股票,波动可能较大,可以和你的退休年期与风险承受度一起检视;PRS每年最高RM3,000税务减免仍是持续供款的考虑之一。
prs.en: Retirement planning looks at decades, not one day's gain. If a PRS fund holds China or Asian equities, swings can be larger, so it may help to review it against your retirement timeline and risk tolerance; the PRS tax relief of up to RM3,000 a year remains one reason to keep contributing.

lump.zh: 如果手上有闲置资金,看到单日大涨可能会心动。一般的原则是分批进场可以分散时间风险,并检查自己是否已过度集中在中国科技股,金额也要与目标和风险承受度相符。
lump.en: If you hold a lump sum, a big one-day jump can be tempting. General principles: phasing in may spread timing risk, check whether you are already concentrated in China tech, and make sure the amount fits your goals and risk tolerance.

bond.zh: 港股与大马债券基金的直接关系有限,但风险偏好回升、油价回落,可能间接缓和通胀与资金外流的担忧,对本地债市(MGS、企业债与伊斯兰债券)偏中性至略为正面。债券基金在股市大起大落时,一般扮演平衡组合的角色。
bond.en: The direct link between Hong Kong stocks and Malaysian bond funds is limited, but better risk appetite and lower oil may indirectly ease inflation and outflow worries, which is generally neutral to mildly supportive for local bonds (MGS, corporate bonds and sukuk). In choppy equity markets, bond funds generally act as a portfolio balancer.

title.zh: 国家银行维持OPR在2.75%不变:今年最后一次利率会议,看好第三季与2027年增长
title.en: Bank Negara holds the OPR at 2.75% at its final meeting of the year, citing strong Q3 growth and a resilient 2027

analysis.zh: 国家银行周四宣布将隔夜政策利率(OPR)维持在2.75%,与经济学家的预期一致,这也是今年最后一次货币政策委员会会议。央行指第三季增长受强劲出口和稳定内需支撑,2027年增长仍具韧性,科技周期和旅游开销是助力;下行风险包括中东冲突拖长。全球通胀因能源成本偏高而上升,这点值得留意。简单说,央行认为目前的利率就像刚好的冷气温度,暂时不必调整。
analysis.en: Bank Negara Malaysia kept the overnight policy rate (OPR) at 2.75% on Thursday, as economists widely expected, at its last monetary policy meeting of the year. It said Q3 growth was supported by strong exports and steady domestic demand, and that 2027 growth should stay resilient, helped by the global technology upcycle and firm tourist spending. Downside risks include a prolonged Middle East conflict, and global inflation is rising on higher energy costs. In plain terms, the central bank sees the current rate as about right for now.

dda.zh: 利率不变意味着短期内环境相对稳定,但这不是进出市场的信号。定期定额(DDA)的价值在于纪律,无论利率会议结果如何都按计划投入,可能有助于平滑成本。
dda.en: An unchanged rate points to a relatively steady backdrop, but it is not a signal to move in or out. The value of DDA is discipline: investing on schedule whatever the rate meeting says may help smooth your cost.

prs.zh: OPR稳定,令退休储蓄的长期回报假设不必频繁调整。PRS每年最高RM3,000的税务减免可作为持续供款的考虑,同时定期检视基金的风险水平是否符合退休年期。
prs.en: A stable OPR means long-term return assumptions for retirement savings need not be revised often. The PRS tax relief of up to RM3,000 a year can be one reason to keep contributing, alongside a regular check that the fund's risk level suits your retirement timeline.

lump.zh: 利率稳定的时候,定存与短期货币市场工具的收益通常也相对稳定。若有一笔闲置资金,可以先考虑用途和时间长短,再决定是否分批进入基金,并检查是否过度集中在单一市场。
lump.en: When rates are steady, returns on fixed deposits and short-term money market instruments are usually steady too. With a lump sum, consider its purpose and time horizon first, then whether to phase into funds, and check for concentration in a single market.

bond.zh: OPR维持不变,通常让大马债券基金(MGS、企业债与伊斯兰债券)的利率风险暂时较为稳定,收益主要来自票息。需留意能源价格带动的通胀和令吉走势,这两项可能影响日后的利率预期。
bond.en: With the OPR unchanged, interest-rate risk for Malaysian bond funds (MGS, corporate bonds and sukuk) is generally steady for now, with returns driven mostly by coupons. Energy-led inflation and the ringgit are worth watching because they may shape future rate expectations.

title.zh: 台股收盘重挫3.20%至41,574.72,成交额9,260亿新台币
title.en: Taiwan shares close down 3.20% at 41,574.72 on NT$926 billion turnover

analysis.zh: 台湾加权指数周四收盘下跌1,374.19点(-3.20%)至41,574.72,成交额9,260.2亿新台币(约282亿美元);早盘开盘已下跌282.78点至42,666.13。美元兑新台币收在32.876。昨天指数收在42,948.91,今天再度走低,显示科技股的波动仍然偏大。波动加大的时候,就像坐在颠簸的车上,系好安全带比猜测下一个弯更重要。
analysis.en: The Taiwan stock index closed down 1,374.19 points, or 3.20%, at 41,574.72 on Thursday, with turnover of NT$926.02 billion (about US$28.2 billion); it had opened down 282.78 points at 42,666.13. The US dollar closed at NT$32.876. Wednesday's close was 42,948.91, so the market extended its slide, showing tech-heavy volatility remains high. In a bumpy ride, a fastened seat belt matters more than guessing the next turn.

dda.zh: 科技股剧烈波动时,单笔押注的风险较高。定期定额(DDA)分散了进场时间,下跌时同样的金额可能买到更多单位,但前提是投资期够长、也在你的风险承受范围内。
dda.en: When tech stocks swing hard, a single bet carries more risk. DDA spreads out your entry timing, and the same amount may buy more units when prices fall, provided your horizon is long enough and the risk is within your tolerance.

prs.zh: 退休基金的时间跨度长,短期的亚洲科技股震荡通常不会改变长期目标。可以借此检视PRS基金的资产配置是否仍符合你的退休年期,而不是因为一天的跌幅而改变计划。
prs.en: Retirement funds have long horizons, and short-term Asian tech swings usually do not change long-term goals. It may be a good time to check whether your PRS fund still suits your retirement timeline rather than changing plans over one day's drop.

lump.zh: 市场大跌后想一次性进场,可能是情绪驱动。一般的原则是分批进入可以分散时间风险,检查对台湾与半导体的集中度,并确认金额与目标和风险承受度相符。
lump.en: The urge to jump in after a big drop can be emotion-driven. General principles: phasing in may spread timing risk, check exposure to Taiwan and semiconductors, and confirm the amount fits your goals and risk tolerance.

bond.zh: 台股下挫对大马债券基金的直接影响有限。风险情绪转弱时,资金有时会流向较稳定的资产,债券基金一般扮演平衡组合的角色;本地债市仍主要看OPR、通胀与令吉。
bond.en: The direct impact of Taiwan's drop on Malaysian bond funds is limited. When risk sentiment weakens, money sometimes moves to steadier assets, and bond funds generally act as a portfolio balancer; local bonds still depend mainly on the OPR, inflation and the ringgit.

title.zh: 油价连跌第四日:布伦特约94.96美元,市场权衡美国期中选举后伊朗战事的走向
title.en: Oil falls for a fourth day with Brent near US$94.96 as markets weigh Iran war risk after the US midterms

analysis.zh: 路透社报道,周四亚洲时段布伦特原油期货报94.96美元,WTI报87.85美元,两者在前一交易日都下跌逾8%,创8月31日以来新低。分析师意见分歧:Sparta Commodities认为市场正计入战事结束的可能,但Citi提醒期中选举后白宫可能更专注外交与军事行动;Eurasia Group将再度遭美军打击的概率由65%下调至60%,并提醒升级可能把布伦特推高至110至125美元。商业库存也接近15年低位,因此油价仍可能大起大落。
analysis.en: Reuters reports Brent futures at US$94.96 and WTI at US$87.85 in Asian trade on Thursday, after both fell more than 8% in the previous session to their lowest since August 31. Analysts differ: Sparta Commodities says markets are pricing a higher chance the war ends, while Citi warns the White House could focus on foreign policy after the midterms. Eurasia Group trimmed its odds of renewed US strikes on Iran to 60% from 65% and said escalation could push Brent to US$110-125. Commercial inventories near 15-year lows also mean prices can stay volatile.

dda.zh: 油价和通胀预期会影响全球股债的短期走势,但很难预测。定期定额(DDA)不依赖预测,按计划持续投入,可能让成本在波动中平均。
dda.en: Oil and inflation expectations affect global stocks and bonds in the short run but are hard to predict. DDA does not rely on forecasts; investing steadily on schedule may average your cost through volatility.

prs.zh: 能源价格会影响生活成本,也影响退休所需的储蓄金额。规划退休时可以把通胀考虑进去,PRS每年最高RM3,000的税务减免可作为持续供款的一个考虑。
prs.en: Energy prices affect living costs and therefore how much you may need in retirement. It helps to build inflation into retirement planning, and the PRS tax relief of up to RM3,000 a year can be one reason to keep contributing.

lump.zh: 油价大幅波动时,能源类股与商品相关基金的价格也可能剧烈起落。一般原则是不要因为短期新闻而集中押注单一主题,分批进入可以分散时间风险,金额也要符合目标和风险承受度。
lump.en: When oil swings sharply, energy stocks and commodity-linked funds can move a lot too. A general principle is not to concentrate on a single theme because of short-term headlines; phasing in may spread timing risk, and the amount should fit your goals and risk tolerance.

bond.zh: 油价回落通常有助缓和通胀压力,对大马债券基金(MGS、企业债与伊斯兰债券)可能偏正面;但国家银行今天提到能源成本偏高仍推升全球通胀,而马来西亚是能源出口国,油价对令吉与财政也有影响,所以效果并不单向。
bond.en: Lower oil generally eases inflation pressure, which may be mildly supportive for Malaysian bond funds (MGS, corporate bonds and sukuk). But Bank Negara noted today that higher energy costs are still lifting global inflation, and as an energy exporter Malaysia sees oil affect the ringgit and fiscal position too, so the effect is not one-way.
